name: Denwa no Bell ga...
source:
The protagonist of this game, a nameless young man, receives a phone call from his girlfriend. She is distressed and asks him to meet her immediately. From that point on, whatever happens depends on what the player decides to do...

[From [url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/pc98/erotic-baka-novel-denwa-no-bell-ga]Moby Games[/url]]
translation:
本作主角是一名没有姓名的年轻男子。一天，他接到女友打来的电话。对方情绪十分低落，请求他立刻出来见面。从这一刻起，之后发生的一切都将取决于玩家的选择……

[引自[url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/pc98/erotic-baka-novel-denwa-no-bell-ga]Moby Games[/url]]
